notes.title: "Renewable Energy & Emirates Revamp" is now live!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Builders![/h2]

We are excited to announce the release of our ninth major update for Kingdoms Reborn!

This update introduces exciting gameplay features to bring new challenges and greater depth to the experience. We’ve also given a vibrant redesign to the Emirates faction, with reimagined buildings and animations to enrich the faction’s aesthetics.


[h2]Renewable Energy and Pollution System![/h2]
Transition to renewable energy to keep pollution under control.
In the Industrial Age, fuel becomes essential for generating electricity to power all production buildings. However, relying on fuel can lead to pollution build-ups, harming citizens' health, happiness and reducing farm yields.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/d86dce4bc06086ad07c378f9ec0004d02340d50c.png[/img]

[h2]Skyscraper Offices[/h2]
This building enhances productivity of all buildings. The more citizens it holds, the greater the bonus. Upgrade it to expand capacity and maximize its effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/5e1d00cc6aa363e8ada201d540a894ba6278240e.png[/img]

[h2]Reimagining of the Emirates faction[/h2]
We’ve completely reimagined the Emirates faction, enriching each building with redesigned structures and animations that improve both clarity and aesthetics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/f37adc37d188bdfc2176585d1b63689a603e282f.png[/img]

The Emirates faction now gains instant visibility of all Oil nodes on the map and also has exclusive access to the Advanced Oil Rig building, establishing fuel advantages over other factions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/73b5de6a57df30cc1b0ad7b4c20033f609e0d2d4.gif[/img]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] All Era 4 buildings now use electricity right away
[*] Replaced World Trade Office with Office
[*] Adjusted resources pricing
[*] Reworked Upgrade Points
[*] Copy building button now requires Wild Card
[*] Countless gameplay rebalance and bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you everyone for your support, we hope you enjoy this new update :)
Kingdoms Reborn Team

notes.title: Major Update: New User Interface Update is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/c7b881b6eeeb1b598382839944b5c4953dc638c6.png[/img]
We are thrilled to announce the release of our eighth major update for Kingdoms Reborn.

This update completely overhauls the game's user interface (UI). We’ve redesigned the UI to be more engaging, and visually stunning. Dive into Kingdoms Reborn and enjoy the dynamic new look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/934e09166eee55fd5edb0582441c4885d2567a84.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/1ff1a8a62a21130493abe5dd3c7cc580eb59d6ab.gif[/img]
We have added the victory screen. Now, when you win, your citizens will cheer and celebrate your success, honoring your hard-fought journey and achievements. This addition not only highlights your accomplishments but also provides a satisfying conclusion to all your efforts, making the endgame experience more rewarding and memorable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/b78e54f5174c50f736d7a23a079aed7258335e14.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/90ec792f768455f5a5d1a3174913e63bceae3038.gif[/img]
We're also pleased to introduce key bindings as part of this update. This feature allows you to customize your controls to better fit your playstyle, making the game more accessible and enjoyable. Head over to the game settings menu to personalize your controls and enhance your experience in Kingdoms Reborn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/bc7544e9a30c12b8151c6a60dd4c23be52a08787.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/836734897df9bcdff90d2244e19ec181fae8a24f.png[/img]
The game HUD visuals have been polished. We reworked the UI backgrounds, and motifs to improve immersion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/cf19abb6c6ddb7eaf687af0b8ec0f330d47d596d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/d93bb8798b3129fee94dc2003f15b9f792c33283.png[/img]
We’ve revamped the in-game graphs with a fresh new design, improving its visuals and functionality. Players can now hover over the graph lines to see exact values, making it easier to analyze information and make better decisions and strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/b50a64e6e1f57a3bbf3a6f15c4e8f28d31819f31.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/705181de19cae7d0cf5da23c7e2360e1f68808fc.png[/img]
Our tutorial book has been completely revamped for a cleaner and easier-to-read experience. The redesigned layout ensures a seamless flow of information, making it intuitive for new players to quickly navigate and understand the game. Each section provides clear and concise information so that newcomers can easily grasp the game's mechanics

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/9a7f6c1247a5c53a1054128a6cda26dddaef08c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/55a1507303845490a3af260a6e9ae8ecd7000687.gif[/img]
We’ve introduced animations to some parts of the UI. These animations not only enhance the visual appeal but also make interacting with the game more fun and enjoyable.

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized citizen simulation for better late-game performance.
[*] Fixed bugs causing lag before 1000 citizens, letting you focus on strategy and growth without performance issues as your kingdom expands.
[/list]

Thank you, everyone. Hope you enjoy the new update :)
Kingdoms Reborn Team

notes.title: Major Update - Introducing Co-op Mode
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Builders![/h3]
With the Steam Summer Sale upon us, we're excited to introduce new features to Kingdoms Reborn, including a new Co-op Mode, Achievements, No Card Draw Mode, AI Dialog, and More!


[h3]Co-op Mode:[/h3]
Team up with your friends to strategize and build a powerful kingdom together!
Hands in hands, multiple players running one kingdom, good teamwork will be key to your success!
[previewyoutube=9HcIVpSe9Vo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Unlock Achievements:[/h3]
We’ve added 30+ Steam achievements to the game!
Prove your skills and unlock a variety of achievements as you progress through the game.
More will be added as we progress through the early access development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/48067b1f705c7883c8581cc40e007e4932909db8.png[/img]


[h3]New Citizen Models:[/h3]
Introducing new citizen models for different factions bringing their cultures to life with their own distinct appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/069a29016591807ca9dd38d1ec68a0f90bb0d160.png[/img]


[h3]No Card Draw Mode:[/h3]
The new No Card Draw Mode removes the randomness of card drawing.
[b]No Card Draw:[/b] Start with 3 wild cards, gain 1 more for each season (no regular card draws).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/708024a47d92f4f46cc0469db8c6ee0dff122430.png[/img]


[h3]Abandon City:[/h3]
Abandon City feature lets you restart your civilization without returning to the main menu.
Perfect for when your population drops to zero or you feel like you run into a death spiral

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/fd3cd29f9f1152a47bb96242536a1ca4dfabb61b.gif[/img]


[h3]AI Dialogues:[/h3]
AI bots now engage in dynamic dialogues, adding new interactions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/f8cd862e64c07dfe9c3834e6c42b22691d92b7f2.png[/img]


[h3]QOL Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Other bug fixes and optimization
[*] Miscellaneous Crash Fixes
[/list]

Hope you all enjoy the new Co-op Mode, unlock some achievements, and try out the new features!

This update comes alongside Steam Summer Sale with a 20% discount from now until July 13th, so now is the perfect time to get your friends onboard!

Thank you for your support, we hope you enjoy this update :)

- Kingdoms Reborn Team

New Military Unit Slots. Increase your Military Slots by growing your population.

notes.title: Major Update: "Beyond the Border" is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hi Kingdom Builders!

After countless refining and beta testing, we are proud to announce our [b]second major update[/b]. 

We've been told you'd like to see a brand-new culture, fresh gameplay styles, more multiplayer interactions, expanded global resources, quality of life improvements, and yes, some military actions — Now here they are! 

See the updates below or find out right away by clicking the [b]PLAY[/b] button now :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/f91d2e6b986a577b87d03b13eb3c43049f78ecca.jpg[/img]

[h3]New faction: “The Emirates”[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Distinct[/b] in-game design and animation.
[*] [b]Master traders:[/b] -20% trading fee. 
[*] [b]Oasis builders:[/b] Able to use Sand to construct buildings, but suffers from -50% wood-cutting yield.
[*] [b]Desert-born:[/b] Starts with Sheep Ranch instead of Forester. Miner’s Fortune replaces Wheat Seeds as a Starting Card option. Has access to techs and buildings adapted to desert living. 
[*] [b]Balance:[/b] Default faction (The Duchies) gets a +5% research speed bonus. 
[/list]
[h3]Expanded interactions with other players[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Conquer:[/b] Vassalize, Raid, Raze or Conquer enemies. Plunder other countries’ riches to make your nation wealthy at their expense. 
[*] [b]Disrupt:[/b] Build Spy Nests and Spy Centers to steal resources and kidnap foreign citizens.
[*] [b]Cooperate:[/b] Enjoy mutual bonuses with allies by building Embassies, Foreign Quarters, and Hotels in their territory. Build Caravansaries to enhance trade routes. 
[*] [b]City states:[/b] Neutral, single-province cities are now scattered throughout the map. 
[*] [b]Smarter AI:[/b] Better city planning, less likely to die off, and faster at growing their economies. The AI now progresses through the eras like players.
[*] [b]Customize your leader:[/b] Choose between different factions, colors, icons, and portraits.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/8e05d93d268ac50ccb20a60f8a60e22991b5c6ac.png[/img]
[h3]Introducing military gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Command[/b] 17 unique units from 6 branches of your military, each with its own strategic advantages. 
[*] [b]Garrison[/b] military units to decrease Steal Card effectiveness.
[*] [b]Build Forts[/b] to protect your provinces from raiding.
[/list]
[h3]More global resources & improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fertility:[/b] Oasis, Irrigation Pump.
[*] [b]Food:[/b] Pita Bread, Cactus Fruits, Agave, Spices.
[*] [b]Luxury:[/b] Dates, Tequila, Toilet Paper, Carpets.
[*] [b]Animals:[/b] Roaming animals can be captured, traded, and displayed in zoos for bonuses.
[*] [b]Ancient Wonders:[/b] 4 unique wonders to discover and claim as your own. Provinces with an Ancient Wonder benefit from an increase in Appeal, province income and Hotel effectiveness. 
[*] [b]Artifacts:[/b] Raid Ruins and Ancient Wonders for Artifacts to display in Museums for bonuses.
[*] [b]Card Buildings:[/b] Zoo, Museum, Card Combiner.
[*] [b]Influence-based buildings:[/b] Manipulate global commodity prices with the World Trade Office and get city-wide bonuses with a Policy Office.
[*] [b]Quality of life:[/b] Non-Rectangular Farms, Centralized Auto-Trade Screen.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/3e46cd35e589c48fec797f46a27fad9e7fa85222.png[/img]

[h3]If you want play on the old saves[/h3]
Please switch to the "pre_beyond_border" branch in your Steam's library setting.

notes.title: "Beyond the Border" patch teaser
notes.content:
Hi everyone. First, to you in the community who provided us with valuable feedback, thank you!

In the upcoming major update, we want to encourage more diverse playstyles and improve late-game gameplay. There are 2 major themes in this upgrade:
[list]
[*]Interacting with the outside world
[*]Introducing a new faction
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38263123/ac4d09cf9a3a55aadb7de53d53a50269bab37a70.png[/img]

[h3]Interacting with the outside world[/h3]

"Beyond the Border" will entice you to interact more with the outside world beyond your own domain (whether with the environment, AI players, or your friends). Now reaching beyond your border could reward you with the strategic boosts you needed to win the game, or cost you if you ignore it. 

[u]Cooperate[/u]
[list]
[*][b]Embassy:[/b] build on an ally's territory, if they like you, to gain bonus effects.
[*][b]Zoo:[/b] collect animals, then trade with others to gain happiness.
[*][b]Hotel:[/b] generate income for you from tourism while increasing happiness for your allies.
[*][b]Ancient Ruins:[/b] boost nearby hotels. May find artifacts from excavations.
[*][b]Museum:[/b] collect and trade artifacts with allies for further boosts.
[/list]
[u]Compete[/u]
[list]
[*][b]Spy Nest:[/b] convert a rival’s house into your hidden Spy Nest. Boost your espionage effectiveness.
[*][b]Spy Center:[/b] boost your espionage effectiveness.
[*][b]Fortification:[/b] stall rival invasion attempts by building it at strategic bottlenecks.
[/list]
[u]Minor neutral cities[/u]
More opportunities to trade, collect tribute, or conquer if they are in your way.



[h3]Introducing a new faction[/h3]

Now there are more incentives to start your settlement in a desert.

[u]The new Arab-inspired faction[/u]
[list]
